summary: Comstock Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the closing of the sale of its legacy mining assets, including all four mining subsidiaries, to Mackay Precious Metals Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Mackay Gold Silver Corp. The aggregate transaction is valued at over $45 million, comprising $20 million in cash and 2 million Mackay shares valued at approximately $4.5 million. Comstock expects to record a gain of $10-$12 million, with no cash taxes. The buyer assumed all reclamation obligations and liabilities. This divestiture aligns with Comstock's strategic shift to renewable metals. What to watch: valuation of the Mackay shares and any post-closing indemnification issues.
